title: Follow-up for #1390: Nested math functions with var() in linear time
items: Let `parse_with` report "not a math function" itself instead of duplicating the name list in `is_math_function_name`.
Deduplicate the string construction in the new test.
Separate fix: nested `atan2()` is still exponential (parse_atan2 retries each argument type); 10 levels with var() take ~8 s.
note: cleanups merged in #1430; atan2 linear-time prototype on claude/proto-atan2-single-parse awaiting maintainer review
